subject: BrightHarbor POC — evaluation plan, success criteria & exec readout scheduling
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightharbor.io>, Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@brightharbor.io>
Cc: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightHarbor follow-up: POC scope & success metrics (recap)

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we draft the mutual action plan: 

1) Goal: validate Redwood inference can meet BrightHarbor’s interactive clinical summarization SLA (median latency < 300ms p50 at 95% of traffic; 90%+ accuracy on the curated test prompts).
2) POC length: 2 weeks (recommended) with an optional 1-week extension if additional edge-case prompts appear.
3) Success criteria (proposal):
   - Performance: p50 latency < 300ms, p95 < 800ms with your 95th-percentile prompt lengths (avg 400 tokens).
   - Quality: >90% pass rate on your gold prompt set (we’ll accept tie-breaker manual review for borderline cases).
   - Stability: <1% error rate (5xx/timeout) under expected concurrency during test window.
   - Cost & throughput baseline: baseline per-token cost + recommended batching profile.
4) Ownership / points of contact:
   - Redwood: Monica (POC lead), Markus (runtime/infra lead).
   - BrightHarbor: Elena (product lead), Tom (technical lead).
5) Data/Access: you’ll share a stripped-down sample of 200 representative prompts and access to a staging API or S3 drop for logs. We will not retain PHI beyond the test window unless you request longer-term retention (we’ll discuss DPA/KMS separately).

Next steps proposed by EOD Wed 8/5:
- Elena/Tom confirm the success criteria or list any additional metrics to include.
- I’ll upload a mutual action plan doc and a simple evaluation spreadsheet (attached) with owners and dates.
- Schedule exec readout tentatively for the week after the POC ends (options below).

Attachments: BH_POC_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (MAP stub), BH_Eval_Criteria_Spreadsheet.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 15min call if you want to walk through the MAP.

—
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
m: 415-555-0142
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightharbor.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Whitaker <tom.whitaker@brightharbor.io>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightHarbor follow-up: POC scope & success metrics (recap)

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick confirmation from our side:
- Overall goal and length (2 weeks) look good. We agree with the proposed success criteria; adding one ask: include a qualitative rubric for hallucination severity (low/medium/high) so our clinical reviewers can flag dangerous outputs.
- We will deliver a 200-prompt sample (anonymized) by Friday 8/7 and provide a staging endpoint (creds to follow).
- Exec readout: tentatively prefer week of 8/24 — we’ll confirm preferred days after we lock the POC window.

One procurement note: our legal/procurement team will want an SOW + short-term data handling annex before the service goes live even for the trial — procurement@brightharbor.io will reach out after we lock scope.

Appreciate the MAP and spreadsheet — we’ll review and get back with any edits.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
VP Product — Clinical Solutions
BrightHarbor Health
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 10:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: resource ask for BrightHarbor POC

Monica / Priyom —

Quick internal note so we’re synced before I reply to Elena:
- I’ll allocate one c5-like dedicated slot on our Dedicated pool (2 GPUs) for the POC window + enable KV caching. That should help hit the p50 target.
- Need Priyom to pre-config the quantization profile for the model variant they’ll test (we should use float16 quant + 4-bit weight mixing) and prepare a fallback model with slightly higher latency but lower token cost.
- Can someone confirm whether BrightHarbor’s prompt distribution leans longer than 400 tokens on weekends? That affects warm-up planning.

I’ll draft a short internal runbook for the monitoring hooks (alerts for >0.5% 5xx, latency SLO breaches).

—Markus
Senior Runtime Engineer

Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 14:48:00 -07:00

Thanks Mark —

I’ll prep the quant profiles and wire up the fallback model by Monday (8/10). I’ll also add the eval hooks so we can collect per-prompt quality metrics and hallucination flags into the spreadsheet.

Action items I’ll own:
- Quantization + fallback model config (due 8/10)
- Instrumentation for per-prompt scoring and hallucination tags (due 8/10)
- Post-POC artifact: a short runbook and cost estimate for a production rollout

If you can confirm the POC window (Mon 8/17 — Fri 8/28) I’ll schedule the infra changes accordingly.

—Priyom
Applied ML Engineer

Hi Elena / Tom —

Per our internal alignment, proposed POC window: Mon 17 Aug — Fri 28 Aug (2-week active testing + 1 extra week as buffer if needed).

Tentative exec readout options (pick one):
- Option A: Tue 8/25 10:00–10:45 PT (mid-POC preliminary readout)
- Option B: Mon 8/31 09:00–09:45 PT (final readout, preferred if you want full results)
- Option C: Tue 9/1 16:00–16:45 PT (alternate final slot)

Please confirm the POC window and one preferred exec readout slot by EOD Tue 8/11 so procurement can start the SOW thread. Once you confirm we’ll send a calendar invite and finalize the MAP and evaluation spreadsheet.

Key reminders:
- We’ll need access to staging creds and the 200 anonymized prompts by 8/14 to hit the 8/17 start date.
- Redwood will provide the MAP and a one-page data handling annex for legal.

Open to a 15m prep call next week if you want to walk execs through the readout format.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Monica Patel
